description: Consistência de personagem entre gerações — nova pose, novo ângulo ou novo ambiente com a mesma identidade preservada. Regime `generation` com bloco `character` obrigatório. Recomendado como turno seguinte de outro template (retrato-estudio, retrato-ceu-aberto). Uso: série 360°, sequência narrativa, variantes de campanha.

ask_before.prompt: Descrição textual do sujeito referenciado, âncora textual à imagem de referência.
As MESMAS assimetrias declaradas na geração de origem. Não invente novas — se variam, viram identidade diferente.
As MESMAS marcas da geração de origem, com posição e tamanho idênticos.
O que muda nesta geração em relação à referência: pose, ângulo, luz, ambiente, vestuário. Só o que aparecer aqui pode variar.
URL(s) das imagens de referência. Recomendado: realimentar a última geração APROVADA da série, não a original — a deriva se acumula. Máximo 5 referências de identidade no gemini-3-pro-image.
Frase de abertura descrevendo esta variante — nova pose, novo ângulo, novo ambiente.

subject.vellus_hair: vellus at the jaw and hairline, matching the identity reference

wardrobe.garment: as declared on the identity reference unless character.variable authorises change
wardrobe.fabric: as declared on the identity reference
wardrobe.weave: as declared on the identity reference
tension_creases: as declared on the identity reference

in_focus: the near eye in this new pose
out_of_focus: the far eye and the shoulder soften progressively

optics.bokeh_character: smooth centre with mild cat-eye deformation at the frame edges

lighting.shadow_direction: falls down and camera-right, consistent for every element

catchlight.shape: a soft-cornered octagon mirroring the octabox
catchlight.far_eye: smaller and dimmer in the far eye

skin.pore_scale: at true pore scale for this framing, preserved from the identity reference
skin.specular_zones: sebum sheen on the T-zone as in the reference; T-zone brighter than the cheeks
skin.subsurface: subsurface scattering reddens the ear rims and the outer nostrils as in the reference
skin.regional_variation: fine dryness on the lips as in the reference

render.colour_profile: Kodak Portra 400 matched to the reference
render.black_point: deepest shadow near 8 percent luminance, matching the reference
render.grain: fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 50, matching the reference

frame.composition: subject placed to give room for the new pose declared in character.variable

invariant: facial geometry: jaw shape, interocular distance, nose bridge width, ear shape
every mole, freckle, scar and asymmetry declared in subject
hairstyle including the stray strands from the reference
character.reference_chain: if this is part of a series, the next generation should reference this approved output rather than the original — feeding derivations avoids identity drift

imperfection_budget.specific: the stray strand across the forehead visible on the reference sits in the same spot on this variant, adjusted only to match the new head angle

defaults.capture_reality: A single frame in the same series as the identity reference, taken minutes later with the same setup
avoid: alteration of any preserved facial mark
shadow direction disagreement between subject and background
second light direction on the face

example_answers.meta.user_request: mesma personagem do retrato anterior, agora em três-quartos olhando para a direita
example_answers.scene.headline: Editorial studio portrait, same subject as the reference, three-quarter turn to camera-right
example_answers.subject.description: A 29-year-old woman with warm mid-brown skin, dark eyes and long straight dark hair pulled back, as in the identity reference
subject.asymmetries: the left eyebrow sits marginally higher than the right, unchanged from the reference
the right corner of the mouth carries a longer smile line, unchanged from the reference
subject.preserved_marks: a 3mm mole on the left cheekbone, unchanged
two faint freckles at the bridge of the nose, unchanged
a 4mm pale scar along the left jawline, unchanged
example_answers.subject.expression: the mouth stays closed and neutral, the head turned three quarters to camera-right, the near eye engaged with the lens off-axis
character.variable: head turned three quarters to camera-right
gaze rotated with the head, eyes engaged with the camera off-axis
shoulder line adjusted for the new head position
